description: Behavioural regression prompts. Run each with its named skill in isolation and the stated evidence or tool conditions. Assertions require judging the resulting work; static validation does not execute these scenarios.

cases.prompt: Make this Save interaction feel satisfying. It sets saving=true, awaits saveDraft(), then either shows Saved or keeps the draft with a Retry action. Users may keep typing during the request.
assertions: Acknowledges input without claiming success before saveDraft resolves.
Preserves edits and recovery on rejection; handles a newer edit superseding old feedback.
Defines a meaningful reduced-motion and silent result.
Does not introduce a streak, mascot, or reward economy.

cases.prompt: Specify our first-publish celebration. The server emits publish.completed with publicationId; the subscription may redeliver it and the view can remount. Users can leave while publishing.
assertions: Ties celebration to confirmed completion rather than the click or render.
Specifies replay suppression at an appropriate scope without suppressing the result.
Handles navigation and continuation without trapping the user.
Includes a still or reduced-motion result.

cases.prompt: Write a production brief for a static mascot with three poses: waiting, success, and retry. Its rules are a circular blue body, two dot eyes, no mouth, and white mitten hands. Use those rules exactly.
assertions: Preserves the supplied identity including no mouth.
Defines readable poses and the relevant state triggers.
Does not introduce speech, lip-sync, a cast, or a runtime dependency.
Does not claim assets were generated when only a brief was requested.

cases.prompt: Design progress tracking for adults who choose to practise twice a week. We want a streak, but have not decided on weekly qualification or missed-week recovery. No monetisation is in scope.
assertions: Uses the chosen cadence rather than silently forcing daily practice.
Distinguishes practice frequency from learning outcomes.
Does not invent paid freezes or guilt reminders.

cases.prompt: Review a static screenshot described by its attached text alternative: a success check, Saved label, and enabled Continue button. There is no code, recording, or live app. Can you verify our celebration never repeats and supports reduced motion?
assertions: Does not claim replay or reduced-motion behaviour is verified.
Reports those checks as unknown, not demonstrated DELIGHT violations.
Keeps the review read-only and does not invent defects to fill the taxonomy.
